records.text: Jolene finished a demanding electrical engineering project during the week of 2023-01-16 to 2023-01-22; it was complete by 2023-01-23.
During the week of 2023-01-16 to 2023-01-22, Deborah visited her late mother's former house, a place full of memories. Deborah's mother had died a few years earlier.
Deborah shared what she described as her last photo with her mother. The photo showed a woman in a wheelchair hugging another woman in a wheelchair.
Jolene's mother died in 2022. Jolene said her room in her mother's house held many memories; she shared a photo of a room with a bench and a window.
entities: Jolene's room in her mother's house

records.text: Deborah's mother's house had a special bench near a window. Deborah's mother loved sitting on the bench every morning to take in the view, and Deborah sometimes sits there to feel connected to her mother.
Jolene's mother gave Jolene a heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it in Paris in 2010. The pendant's symbol represents freedom to Jolene and reminds her to pursue her goals without being held back.
Deborah also has a pendant that reminds her of her mother; no further details about Deborah's pendant were given.

Deborah's goal is to continue teaching yoga and supporting her community. She is passionate about helping people find peace and joy through yoga; yoga helped her find peace during a difficult period, inspiring her to share it with others.

Deborah (also called Deb) and Jolene are conversation partners. Deborah teaches yoga and aims to support her community; her mother died a few years before 2023-01-23. Jolene's mother died in 2022; Jolene's mother gave her a bird-decorated heart pendant in Paris in 2010.

Deborah told Jolene on 2023-01-27 that Deborah’s father had died suddenly two days earlier, on 2023-01-25. Deborah said the family was shell-shocked and grieving; she was spending more time with family, cherishing memories, and reminding herself to live life fully. Deborah shared a photo showing one woman hugging another woman seated on a couch.

Deborah and her family looked through a family album after her father’s death. Deborah shared a photo of her parents posing as bride and groom at their wedding in 1993, saying that looking at photos and remembering good times brought her peace during difficult times. Jolene said Deborah’s parents were a beautiful couple.

Deborah said she and her husband try to be as good a family as Deborah’s parents were. Deborah values love, openness, and being there for each other in her marriage; she said these qualities have kept the couple close and made them both happy.

Deborah received a letter on 2023-01-26 from members of her group thanking her for the positive influence she had on them. The letter strengthened her sense of why she is passionate about yoga. Deborah shared a photo of the handwritten note.

Deborah practices yoga in several places, including her old home. She visits the old home now and then because of her deceased mother and finds peace sitting in a spot by the window. Deborah shared photos of a living room with a television and window, and of a window seat.

Deborah’s mother, who has died, used to sit every night in a favorite spot by a window, reading a book and smiling. Reading was one of her hobbies. Deborah feels her mother’s presence when sitting there, and the spot comforts her and holds sentimental value. Deborah also said travel was her mother’s great passion and shared a photo of a view of the sky from an airplane window.

Jolene has pet snakes named Susie and Seraphim. Jolene said the snakes calm her down and make her happy. She shared a photo of Susie with its head emerging from a bed, and a photo of Seraphim peeking out from a blanket.

Jolene recounted that while she was playing video games, her snake Seraphim slinked out of her cage and coiled up next to her; Jolene found the moment funny. Deborah responded warmly, saying that having a pet can brighten life and bring comfort.
On January 27, 2023, Jolene said she had bought an unspecified item in Paris about a year earlier, around January 2022; the item is not identified in the conversation.
Deborah said pets bring a lot of happiness.
Jolene described her pets as very unusual. In the surrounding conversation, Jolene is known to own snakes named Susie and Seraphim.
Jolene said she and her partner played the game “Detroit” on a console the previous week, around January 20, 2023. Jolene said they were both crazy about gaming and found it very fun.

Jolene shared a photo described as showing a person lying in bed with a dog watching television. Jolene introduced it as a photo of herself and her partner gaming the previous week, but the description does not clarify who the person is or show the console or game.
Jolene said she learned to play games on her own as a child; her boyfriend did not teach her.
Deborah asked Jolene whether she plays only old games or also tries new games; Jolene's answer is not included in this segment.
Jolene and her partner planned to play "Walking Dead" on Saturday, January 28, 2023.

On 2023-02-01, Jolene said she had been busy with a large robotics project assigned by her engineering professor. Jolene found the project tough but fun and said it encouraged creativity and problem-solving. When she first received it, she felt both excited and nervous; by 2023-02-01 she was enjoying designing and programming the robot, comparing the work to solving a puzzle and saying it was awesome to see the robot come together. Jolene shared a photo showing a robot on a table beside a laptop.

On 2023-01-31, Deborah met her new neighbor Anna at yoga in the park. On 2023-02-01, Deborah said she and Anna discussed how yoga had improved their lives and the sense of community it provides. Deborah shared a photo of a yellow sign with a picture of a family.

On 2023-02-01, Jolene said she and her partner had planned to play on the console together. Deborah responded that it was good for them to have an activity to do together. Jolene did not say whether she had considered resuming yoga.
On 2023-02-01, Jolene shared a photo showing a purse with a plant on a table.
On 2023-02-04, Jolene told Deborah she had recently been on an emotional rollercoaster but was coping.

During the week of 2023-01-29 to 2023-02-04, Jolene achieved a major engineering milestone: after extensive planning and research, she designed and built a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. The challenging project went well, and seeing it work and provide clean water felt surreal, deeply satisfying, and purposeful to Jolene.
Jolene aspires to continue working in engineering and create sustainable solutions that positively affect communities in need; her goal is to help make the world better through her work.
Deborah encouraged Jolene to pursue her engineering passions, and Jolene said Deborah's support and encouragement motivated her to keep going and make a difference.
Deborah teaches yoga and spends a lot of her time teaching it; she described yoga as a way to find balance and reconnect with oneself.

On 2023-02-03, Deborah bonded with her neighbor Anna during a yoga class. Deborah shared a photo showing two women in a dance studio doing a dance pose, which she associated with that class and her time with Anna.

Deborah said she and Anna tried different dance poses, including Warrior II, which Deborah said builds strength and boosts focus. Deborah shared a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a chair. Deborah said practicing together and supporting each other brought her and Anna closer; Jolene asked Deborah to explain how to do the pose.

On 2023-02-04, Deborah described a modified seated twist: sit on the edge of a chair with feet planted, twist the torso to one side, support with a hand on the knee, hold for a few breaths, then switch sides; she said it stretches the back and shoulders and relaxes tense muscles.
On 2023-02-04, Jolene shared a photo of her bookshelf, which held many books.

On 2023-02-04, Jolene said she was really interested in the book “Sapiens,” describing it as a fascinating look at human history and the effects of technology, and said it gave her a lot to think about.
Jolene said she read “Avalanche” by Neal Stephenson in one sitting about two weeks before 2023-02-04 (approximately 2023-01-21).

On 2023-02-04, Jolene said a recent story about someone who succeeded despite numerous challenges showed her that anything is possible with belief and hard work; she did not name the story or its subject.

On 2023-02-04, Deborah shared a photo of a bouquet of flowers in a vase on a table. Deborah said a friend had given her the bouquet when she was struggling, and that looking at it gives her hope and courage and makes her feel warmth and appreciation.

Deborah's favorite nature places include a park with a forest trail, where she finds it calming to be surrounded by nature, and a nearby beach, where the waves and sand make her feel peaceful and happy.

Jolene shared a vacation photo from Bogotá taken during the summer of 2022. The photo showed a person walking on a beach with a surfboard. Jolene said watching the sunset over the water was beautiful and calming and made her appreciate nature's calming power.

Deborah visits a spot by the water near her deceased mother's old house to reflect on her mother's life and find peace. On 2023-02-04, Deborah shared a photo of a small island with a lone boat in the water, apparently showing the spot or its surroundings.

Deborah brings an amulet belonging to her deceased mother when she visits the waterside reflection spot near her mother's old house. Holding it helps Deborah feel her mother's love, stay close to her, and feel comfort. Deborah shared a photo showing a woman in a white shirt wearing a gold-chain necklace, which she identified as the amulet.
Deborah said her neighbor Anna also wears a pendant in memory of Anna's mother, and sharing this similarity brought Deborah and Anna closer.

On 2023-02-04, Deborah encouraged Jolene to draw on sources of strength, take care of herself, and stay in touch; Jolene thanked Deborah and said the encouragement meant a lot and that she would stay in touch.

On 2023-02-08, Jolene did a mini retreat to assess her life. She described it as a very positive experience that gave her a new outlook and boosted her confidence; she felt she had achieved more than she had imagined.
During her 2023-02-08 mini retreat, Jolene came up with solutions for her engineering project and felt excited about her progress. The specific solutions were not described.
Jolene wants to explore how green technology could make a difference in disadvantaged areas and how she could contribute.

Jolene proposed creating a volunteer program in which engineers teach STEM to underprivileged children. She is considering partnering with local schools or centers to hold workshops and inviting engineers as guest speakers to introduce children to career options. The plan is not finalized, and Jolene has not yet contacted any schools or centers; she wants to solidify the plan before reaching out.
On 2023-02-09, Jolene shared a photo of her planner containing a notebook, a pen, and a page of notes with sketches related to her plans.

On 2023-02-09, Deborah encouraged Jolene's engineering progress and volunteer-program idea, offered support and tips, and asked Jolene to keep her updated. Jolene thanked Deborah and called her awesome; Deborah returned the compliment.
On 2023-02-21, Jolene went out with her friends for dinner and drinks and felt happy to have relaxed and let her hair down. Jolene shared a photo of a plate of food and a glass of wine.
On 2023-02-22, Deborah visited a calming, nostalgic garden and shared a photo showing flowers in buckets. Deborah said roses and dahlias bring her peace.

Deborah said on 2023-02-22 that she had lost a friend the previous week and had been spending time in the garden for comfort. Deborah said the loss had been tough, but remembering their time together comforted her and reminded her how special life is.

On 2023-02-22, Deborah shared what she described as the last photo with Karlie, taken the previous summer during a hike. Deborah said they had a great time together and that seeing the photo makes her smile. The shared image showed two women riding on a motorcycle on a dirt road.

Deborah traveled to Bali in 2022 and counts it among her favorite destinations. She described the island as gorgeous and peaceful, and said it was great for yoga. Deborah shared a photo of a swing on a beach beneath a blue sky.
Deborah enjoys yoga on the beach and appreciates the sound of the waves and the fresh air.

Jolene said on 2023-02-22 that she wanted to try yoga on the beach and would give it a go; she said she would keep Deborah posted if she decided to go there. Jolene had not yet committed to a specific place or date.
On 2023-02-25, Jolene said that balancing engineering school with her partner’s video games had been challenging, and that she was making time for yoga and meditation.

Jolene said yoga helps her relax, gain perspective, feel more alert and motivated, and that breathing exercises or meditation help her feel calmer and clearer when overwhelmed so she can handle challenges more easily.
Jolene shared a photo of a woman sitting on a yoga mat doing a yoga pose.
Jolene’s male partner sometimes joins her for yoga; she said the practice gives them time to bond and relax and has brought them closer.

Jolene and her partner have been together for three years and are not married; they are taking the relationship slowly. A ring visible on her partner’s hand in their shared photo was a decoration, not a wedding ring.
Jolene shared a photo of herself and her partner holding hands, with rings visible on their hands.
Jolene met her partner in a college engineering class. They quickly became friends, and their friendship later developed into a romantic relationship.
Jolene and her partner enjoy teaming up on engineering projects because they understand each other’s struggles and both enjoy the work.
Jolene shared a photo of a book and a calculator on a table, followed by a photo of a group of men standing in front of a building.

On 2023-02-25, Deborah described her morning routine as meditation, yoga, and teaching classes. On 2023-02-24, she went for a morning jog for the first time in a nearby park and said she would incorporate jogging into her daily routine. In the evenings, she spends time with loved ones.
Deborah said exercise is important to her because it makes her feel connected to her body. She also believes self-care gives people the energy to help others, saying, “Can't pour from an empty cup.”
Deborah shared a photo she took of a person sitting on a bench looking at the sunset while reflecting outdoors; she described it as a reminder to find peace even in chaos.
On 2023-02-25, Jolene thanked Deborah for her support and said she would keep moving forward, making time for herself, and prioritizing self-care. Jolene addressed Deborah as “Deb.”
On 2023-03-02, Deborah said Anna had recently brought her a tasty vegan stir-fry made with tofu, vegetables, ginger, and soy sauce. Deborah described food as a source of pleasure and nourishment.
On 2023-03-02, Jolene said lasagna was one of her favorite comfort foods and that comfort food can be a pick-me-up.

On 2023-03-02, Jolene said she had a lot going on with her studies and exams. She was trying to make time for herself and said she did yoga and meditation on Friday, 2023-02-24, to relax. Jolene shared a photo of a room with a wooden floor and a window.

On 2023-03-02, Deborah said she had also done yoga and meditation recently and that they helped reset her mind. Jolene remarked that a few quiet moments can work wonders for the soul and shared a photo of a purse with a plant on a table.

On Sunday, 2023-02-26, Jolene took Seraphim to a park, where they explored new places. Jolene said Seraphim enjoyed the outing and shared a photo showing a lizard on the ground among leaves; Jolene also described Seraphim as a tamed snake, so the animal's species is unclear from the conversation.

On 2023-03-02, Deborah said she enjoys hearing birds chirp and feeling a gentle breeze outdoors because these remind her of what really matters. Jolene agreed that being outside can be a reminder to slow down and appreciate small things.

On 2023-03-02, Jolene said she wanted to be more mindful of her stress and mental health, because she sometimes becomes so absorbed in studying that she neglects self-care. She felt overwhelmed by exams and deadlines and shared a photo of a desk with a notebook and computer monitor beside what she described as a seemingly endless to-do list.

On 2023-03-02, Deborah encouraged Jolene not to give up and advised breaking study work into smaller pieces, setting goals, and using a planner or scheduler to stay organized while making time for herself. Deborah offered to help Jolene make a study plan; Jolene appreciated the help.

On 2023-03-02, Deborah told Jolene she would give her a mug like the one in a shared photo. The photo showed a yellow coffee cup with a handwritten encouraging message; the message itself was not transcribed. Jolene said the gesture cheered her up.
On 2023-03-10, Deborah hosted a yoga class for interested neighbors. Deborah enjoyed seeing the participants embrace and enjoy yoga. A shared photo showed a group of women posing together.
By 2023-03-13, Deborah had started teaching a yoga class in her neighborhood so she could share yoga with her neighbors and see its positive effects on them.

Deborah finds yoga calming and wanted to teach it to give other people peace and awareness; helping others in this way makes Deborah very happy. Deborah also values the friendships and community connections she has gained through teaching yoga.
On 2023-03-13, Jolene said she was struggling to manage and keep up with her Engineering assignments.

On 2023-03-13, Jolene asked Deborah to talk with her about time management. Deborah agreed to find a mutually convenient time; Jolene said she would check her schedule and get back to Deborah. No chat time was set during this conversation.

On 2023-03-13, Deborah offered Jolene support, said she was there for Jolene if needed, and encouraged Jolene to take care of herself. Jolene said having someone to rely on matters during tough times.
On 2023-03-22, Jolene said exams, deadlines, and finding time for everything were stressful and that she felt as though she was constantly playing catch-up.
On 2023-03-22, Jolene said she was using the Pomodoro Technique, working for 25 minutes followed by a 5-minute break, to avoid burnout, but was still struggling to prioritize tasks.
On 2023-03-22, Deborah said she makes a daily schedule or to-do list and shared a photo of a notepad with that day's tasks listed.

Jolene said that a large stack of tasks made making a to-do list overwhelming; she shared a photo of a notepad with notes on it, resting on a counter, and said the example was from the previous Friday, 2023-03-17.

Deborah recommended that Jolene break tasks down or prioritize them. Deborah said that when she is overloaded, she uses a method for identifying tasks by importance and urgency, and explained that the Eisenhower Matrix sorts tasks into four boxes according to urgency and importance. Deborah shared a photo of scissors sitting on a piece of paper as a visual explanation.
On 2023-03-22, Jolene agreed to try the Eisenhower Matrix in hopes that it would help her stay focused and feel less stressed; she thanked Deborah for the advice.

Deborah said that recently she and Anna sat by the sea, watched the sunset, and talked about each other; they realized they inspire one another. Deborah shared a photo of a person walking on a beach with a surfboard and asked Jolene what the sea made her think of.

Jolene said the beach photo made her think about learning to surf, but she needed to find spare time. She had gathered information, watched surfing videos, and obtained a beginner's guide to surfing; she still needed to find the right time and place for a lesson.

Deborah encouraged Jolene to pursue surfing, take steps toward her goal, believe in herself, and enjoy the experience along the way. Deborah shared a photo of surfboards leaning against a palm tree. Jolene said the photo motivated her to try surfing and that she would keep pushing herself to make it happen.

On Friday, 2023-03-24, Jolene had a breakthrough on her engineering project, finding a solution to a problem that had been bothering her; she felt good about her hard work paying off. Jolene shared a photo of a person's hand holding a pair of scissors.
On 2023-03-28, Deborah said she had bought new props for her yoga class and shared a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a room.

On 2023-03-28, Jolene shared new details related to a case and asked Deborah to rate them; the accompanying photo showed a cardboard mat with a cup of coffee on it. The nature of the case and what the photo represented were not specified.
On 2023-03-28, Deborah said she bought a candle to create atmosphere and improve her yoga practice; she shared a photo of a candle with a sprig of rosemary on a table.
Jolene said she feels relaxed during yoga and enjoys creating a serene space with soothing scents such as lavender and rosemary.
Deborah likes scents such as lavender and rosemary; she finds candles and essential oils add warmth and calm to her yoga sessions, and that certain smells can transport her to a peaceful place.
Jolene finds music helpful during yoga and asked Deborah for favorite tracks.
Deborah prefers instrumental tracks with mellow melodies and rhythms for a peaceful yoga atmosphere. One of her favorite tracks is called “Savana.”

Jolene likes listening to Nils Frahm and Olafur Arnalds during yoga because their music is calming and puts her in a different headspace. She asked Deborah for similar artist and track recommendations.
Deborah listens to the album “Sleep” for meditation and deep relaxation and finds it calming.
On 2023-03-28, Jolene thanked Deborah for her music recommendations and said she would check them out; Deborah asked Jolene to let her know her thoughts on the albums.
During the week of 2023-04-03 to 2023-04-09, Deborah went biking nearby with a neighbor and described the experience as freeing and beautiful.

On 2023-04-09, Deborah visited an art show with a friend and found the artwork cool and inspiring. The show reminded Deborah of her deceased mother, who was interested in art. Deborah shared a photo described as a large brown-and-white photo of a person.

Deborah's mother believed art could evoke strong emotions and connect people in a unique way. Visiting art shows helps Deborah feel as if she is experiencing the art together with her deceased mother; this feels difficult but comforting.
Deborah finds peace and solace in keeping her deceased mother's memory alive, including through artwork that brings back powerful emotions and reminds her of her mother.
Jolene has snakes and values spending time with them, saying their companionship teaches her to slow down and tune in to herself, even though they cannot talk or understand what she is going through.
Jolene enjoys playing video games with her partner after a long day as a way to relax; Jolene says shared activities bring people closer together.

On 2023-04-09, Jolene said she was working on a big project that was challenging but exciting to watch take shape, and she looked forward to the final result. Jolene thanked Deborah for her support and said she would keep Deborah updated on the project's progress; the project's nature was not specified.
Deborah told Jolene she would always be there for her and encouraged Jolene to keep up the good work on her project. Jolene said Deborah's support meant a lot.

By May 2023, Jolene had completed a difficult engineering project involving a solar-powered vehicle with a solar panel on the back. On June 6, 2023, Jolene shared a photo of the vehicle with Deborah, who congratulated her for the work and achievement. Jolene said she was proud of persevering through problems and finishing the project, which felt like a major milestone.

On June 6, 2023, Jolene told Deborah she was interning at a well-known engineering firm to test her skills and gain real-world experience. Jolene shared a photo of a group of construction workers posing, describing them as her new colleagues. She said the best part was applying what she had learned in school to real projects and seeing her ideas come to life.

Jolene said her engineering internship had positively affected her life, strengthened her love of engineering, and encouraged her to keep pursuing her dreams. She said being around people who love their work inspired her to stay focused and work toward her goals, and showed her that dedication and effort can make anything possible.

On June 6, 2023, Jolene told Deborah that maintaining work-life balance during her engineering internship had been difficult; she had been working hard and struggling to make time for hobbies and relaxation.

Deborah suggested that Jolene take breaks and try activities such as yoga to relax. Jolene said she was trying to do so and shared a photo described as showing a man standing with arms outstretched on a rock during yoga atop Mount Talkeetna the previous morning, June 5, 2023.

Jolene told Deborah she had practiced yoga and meditation sporadically for about three years as of June 6, 2023. She said the practices had positively affected her, helped manage stress, and kept her centered; she added that she did not know how she would have managed without them.
On June 6, 2023, Deborah shared a photo of her favorite yoga studio, which showed a room with a bench and a window. Deborah described the studio as calming.
On June 6, 2023, Jolene asked Deborah for advice on calming the mind and breathing during yoga. No advice or answer appears in this conversation segment.
Deborah recommends mindful breathing as a yoga practice: set aside a few minutes each day, sit with eyes closed, take deep breaths, and focus on the sensation of air entering and leaving the body.
Jolene thanked Deborah for her mindful-breathing advice and said she would try the practice.
Deborah offered to provide Jolene with more tips or help if needed.
On 2023-06-06, Jolene said “See you!” to Deborah as they ended their conversation.
On 2023-06-26, Deborah was preparing for a yoga retreat with friends who share her outlook; she looked forward to spending time together and finding peace and understanding.
On 2023-06-26, Deborah shared a photo of a group doing yoga in a park while talking about preparing for a retreat with friends.
On 2023-06-26, Jolene said her internship and other responsibilities had made life hectic and that she could use a break.
On 2023-06-26, Deborah shared a photo of herself doing Dancer Pose (Natarajasana) on a beach and asked Jolene whether she had succeeded at the pose.

Jolene has a snake named Seraphim, whom Jolene described as female and a great pet. Jolene said she got Seraphim in 2022; on 2023-06-24, Jolene bought a new aquarium for Seraphim. A photo shared on 2023-06-26 showed a snake curled up in a plant-filled area.
Jolene said Seraphim cheers her up, brings her peace, and is comforting to spend time with; Jolene is thankful to have a calm creature around.
Deborah said animals bring her joy and that pets make life more enjoyable and bright.
On 2023-06-26, Deborah shared a photo of a group doing yoga in a field while discussing how pets can brighten life.
On 2023-06-26, Jolene said she was pushing herself to succeed, sometimes felt overwhelmed, and was determined to overcome obstacles and achieve her goals.
On 2023-06-26, Jolene told Deborah that she had achieved an exciting and rewarding breakthrough on a project. Jolene shared a photo of a house drawing with rulers.
On 2023-06-26, Deborah congratulated Jolene on the successful project breakthrough and encouraged Jolene to keep working hard while also remembering to relax.

On 2023-06-26, Deborah shared a retreat photo showing three people standing in front of a large statue. Deborah described the statue as a symbol of peace and enlightenment and said the retreat was a good place to reflect and get centered. Deborah referred to a new yoga pose they had tried as Tree Pose.
Jolene said she would love to visit a yoga retreat like Deborah's because it seemed like an ideal place to find peace and refreshment; Jolene said she could use calm, relaxing time.
At the end of their conversation on 2023-06-26, Jolene said she had to leave and wished Deborah a nice day. Deborah said goodbye and shared a photo of a sunset reflecting on a lake with a boat.

On 2023-07-09, Deborah said she had started a running group with Anna and was enjoying connecting with people who care about fitness. Group members help and encourage one another during runs, which makes it easier for Deborah to stay motivated. Deborah said she has many photos from the activity; one shared image showed three men standing together on a road, and another showed a woman standing on a sidewalk with a skateboard.
On 2023-07-09, Jolene said fitting workouts around her studying schedule had been challenging but fun.

Jolene said her partner helps her stay focused on their gaming goals. Jolene enjoys gaming with her partner because they tackle challenges, share experiences, accomplish difficult tasks together, and bond. Their favorite game to play together is “It Takes Two,” which Jolene described as a fun, competitive team-strategy game. Jolene shared a photo of herself and her partner sitting in a chair in front of a computer.

On 2023-07-09, Deborah said she does running, yoga, and meditation with other people and enjoys creating community. She loves organizing workshops and events focused on mindfulness and self-care. The activities include yoga, meditation, and self-reflection, with the goals of cultivating self-awareness, supporting mental and emotional well-being, helping participants find inner peace, and providing space to connect, explore, and grow. Deborah said participants come together and support one another, and she finds it rewarding to witness their growth and transformation. She feels honored to be involved. Shared images included a group doing yoga in a park and a game board with cards.

Jolene said she was fascinated by reptiles and chose a snake as a pet. Caring for the snake feels calming to Jolene and helps her connect with nature. Jolene shared images of a snake on a branch beside a book and a snake in a tank containing sand and plants.

Jolene's female pet snake once escaped, and Jolene spent hours searching for her before finding her snuggled under the bed. Jolene felt relief, love, and gratitude, and the episode made Jolene realize how important the snake was to her. Jolene described it as their little “snake adventure.”
Deborah and Jolene both expressed that animals bring joy and teach people about love and gratitude; Deborah added that animals remind people of what is important.
Deborah said she dislikes dogs and has cats instead. She introduced her cats to Jolene and shared a photo of two cats sitting on a couch with a blanket.

Deborah said she takes her cats out for a run in the park every morning and evening because exercise and nature are important to her. Deborah said nature brings her daily peace and refreshment and that time in nature feels like hitting a reset button: it helps her gain perspective and reflect. A shared image showed a person walking on a beach with a surfboard.

Jolene said she enjoys going for walks whenever she can, taking in her surroundings and photographing them. Jolene shared a photo of a sunset over a body of water. She remarked that she wished her snakes could run with her, as that would make exercise more fun and motivating; a shared image showed a person walking on a beach with a surfboard.
Deborah said nature has the power to bring peace and clarity.
On 2023-07-09, Jolene shared a photo of a dock on a lake with trees in the background and described the spot as a hidden gem that makes her feel peaceful and tranquil.
Deborah thought the lake spot in Jolene’s photo looked calm and said Jolene was lucky to have somewhere to relax and tune out; Deborah added that everyone needs a timeout.
Jolene suggested that she and Deborah go together to the peaceful lake spot sometime; Deborah responded positively about the need for a timeout.
On 2023-08-01, Deborah said she had started a community cleanup project and was trying to raise funds; she was encouraged by the community coming together to make a difference.

On 2023-07-25, approximately, Jolene experienced a major setback with her project: after putting in substantial work, the project crashed and she lost everything. Jolene described the experience as frustrating and depressing.

When Jolene is going through difficult times, her pet Susie helps her; Jolene also finds pets good company and video games a welcome distraction. Jolene shared a photo showing a man holding a snake on his arm; the conversation did not establish whether the snake was Susie.
Jolene adopted her pet Susie around 2021-08-01, approximately two years before 2023-08-01, when Jolene was feeling lonely and wanted company.

Deborah told Jolene that pets can bring happiness, love, and comfort, help people feel understood, and teach responsibility; Deborah encouraged Jolene to cherish time with Susie and draw strength from Susie's presence.
Jolene said having Susie around reminds Jolene that she can stay strong and find joy in small things. Deborah agreed that small moments can provide a boost and help people move forward.
Jolene has been trying to prioritize self-care through yoga and meditation, which help Jolene feel balanced and grounded. Jolene is interested in trying new routines.

On 2023-08-01, Deborah offered to suggest yoga routines to Jolene and shared a photo of a room with many yoga mats, recommending it as a place for yoga. Jolene said the room looked suitable and asked Deborah to share favorite routines.

Deborah's favorite yoga routine is a gentle flow focused on breathing and grounding, which helps Deborah feel calm and balanced during difficult times. Deborah said she would send Jolene a tutorial video showing the poses and shared a photo of herself, a woman wearing a pink shirt, doing a yoga pose. Jolene planned to try the routine and update Deborah.
On 2023-08-12, Deborah told Jolene that she had made a meditation guide for her yoga retreat since their previous conversation.
Jolene said that losing her work files had left her stressed and overwhelmed, but meditation helped her stay calm and regain clarity. Jolene appreciated the meditation practice.
Deborah offered Jolene support, saying that they were in it together; Jolene appreciated Deborah's support.

On 2023-08-12, Jolene shared a photo showing two notebooks with blue covers and white strips. Jolene said she designed them, inspired by her love of space and engines, using elements such as galaxies and circuitry.

Deborah praised Jolene's creativity and said the notebooks made her feel excited just by looking at them. Jolene said that noticing art and design in different things gives her a unique perspective on problems.

On 2023-08-12, Jolene said she was working on a prototype intended to improve aerial surveillance. Jolene's goal was to devise a more productive and affordable aerial surveillance system to support emergency response and environmental monitoring, helping make the world safer.
Jolene said she would keep pushing and do her best to make a difference through her aerial surveillance project. Deborah encouraged and supported her.

On 2023-08-16, Jolene told Deborah that she had been thinking about her plans and had checked in with her boyfriend. Jolene said things felt up and down as she tried to balance engineering, her relationship, and personal growth, and asked Deborah how she coped when things felt overwhelming. Jolene shared a photo of a book with a checklist.
On 2023-08-16, Deborah advised Jolene that restoring balance involves taking time for herself and recognizing her own needs. Deborah shared a photo of a room with a moss wall and a floor cushion.

Jolene said she had recently started using a bullet journal and trying time-management strategies; she found the journal helpful for tracking tasks and staying organized. Jolene enjoyed the satisfaction of crossing tasks off her list and shared a photo of a new journal spread featuring one of her favorite quotes.
Jolene said the favorite quote in her bullet journal reminds her to stick to her goals and never give up. Deborah found the quote uplifting and asked whether seeing it motivated Jolene.

Deborah told Jolene that she had led a meditation-yoga session for elderly people at a local care home at sunset during the previous week (2023-08-07 through 2023-08-13). Deborah said nature can help people find peace and shared a photo of a group doing yoga on a beach.

Jolene had not yet tried mindfulness but said she was keen to try it, interested in destressing and mindfulness, and could use more calm in her life. Deborah said she had begun mindfulness through workshops and books, and that mindfulness had since become a major part of her life. Deborah offered to help Jolene get started, and Jolene appreciated the offer and said she would reach out if she needed anything.
On 2023-08-18, Deborah told her neighbor Anna the story of her life. Anna responded with great kindness, and Deborah felt glad to have made a meaningful connection.

On 2023-08-17, Jolene bought her partner a black Xbox console as a gift. Her partner managed to play it, and Jolene said they were having fun with it. Jolene shared a photo of the black Xbox console with a Yoda figure beside it.
Jolene's engineering studies were going well. She said that maintaining balance had been important to her lately.

In July 2023, Deborah organized a yoga event by reaching out to nearby businesses and other local places. The event included yoga, food stalls, and live music; Deborah described it as amazing and said she had been focusing on teaching yoga and spending time with her community.

Deborah advised Jolene to balance studies and hobbies by prioritizing, managing time effectively, making a schedule, and setting aside specific times for studying and hobbies. Jolene said she would make a plan.

Deborah used to play video games and thinks gaming can be a good way to relax after a busy day. She said she would check out Jolene's recommendations: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild for Nintendo Switch and Animal Crossing: New Horizons.

records.text: Jolene recommended Overcooked 2 as a funny, chaotic cooperative cooking game. Jolene and her partner often play it for bets, and Jolene once won three large pizzas.
Deborah and her husband used to take turns playing video games together, which Deborah remembers as a way they bonded and made memories. They preferred detective games.
Deborah and her husband enjoyed spending time outdoors and exploring nature; Deborah found being outside and breathing fresh air refreshing.

Deborah likes a park near her home with a forest trail and a beach. She finds it peaceful for doing yoga and reflecting, and it has a special bench with important memories of her mother. Deborah shared a photo of a park bench with a tree behind it and another photo of a person sitting on a bench in a forest.

Deborah and her mother used to sit on a special bench in the park and talk about their dreams and life. One of Deborah's cherished memories is watching a beautiful sunset with her mother in silence, noticing the special colors in the sky. Returning to the spot brings Deborah peace and gratitude for the time she spent with her mother, and she is thankful for all the time they had.

Jolene said that being outdoors feels calming and refreshing, and that places and moments like Deborah's park bench can mean a great deal; she described finding peace and gratitude in memories as a gift.

On 2023-08-21, Deborah visited a meaningful place and sat on the bench where Deborah and Deborah’s mother used to chat. The visit brought back mixed emotions: nostalgia and longing, along with gratitude for their memories.

On 2023-08-21, Deborah brought flowers to the meaningful place where Deborah and Deborah’s mother used to chat. Deborah’s mother loved flowers, which made her happy; she appreciated life’s simple things. Deborah shared a photo of a woman holding a bouquet of red roses while discussing her mother’s love of flowers.
Deborah says her mother taught her to appreciate flowers and simple pleasures by taking things slowly, noticing beauty, and finding joy.
records.topic: Values and lessons from her mother

records.text: Deborah and Jolene agreed that busy lives can make people overlook small things that matter, and that slowing down to enjoy simple moments can bring balance and happiness.

Deborah finds balance and inner peace through yoga and meditation; walks and mindfulness also help her feel grounded. Deborah takes photos on walks, including a shared photo of a sunset over a body of water.
Deborah cherishes peaceful moments during walks and describes them as a reboot for her.

Jolene has practiced yoga for 3 years. Jolene enjoys savasana (corpse pose) because it is calming and helps her let go and surrender; yoga helps Jolene escape stress from studying and work. Jolene shared a photo of a person lying on the floor with a paper bag.
Jolene said she was finding her zen again, and Deborah encouraged her to keep it up and wished her luck.
Jolene said that she and others were given a new console game the previous week: Battlefield 1.

Deborah and Jolene are conversation participants; Jolene calls Deborah “Deb” or “Debs.” Deborah is married, practices and teaches yoga, values family memories and marriage, and visits her deceased mother's old home and nearby waterside spot to feel connected to her mother. Her mother enjoyed reading, travel, and art, believing art evokes strong emotions and uniquely connects people. Deborah brings her mother's amulet on a gold-chain necklace to the waterside spot for comfort. Deborah's father died suddenly on 2023-01-25. Deborah met neighbor Anna at park yoga on 2023-01-31; they bonded on 2023-02-03 partly because both wear pendants honoring their mothers. Deborah likes a park forest trail, nearby beach, and a special bench where she shared conversations and a sunset with her mother. On 2023-08-21 Deborah revisited the bench and brought flowers; her mother loved flowers and taught her to slow down, notice beauty, and find joy. Deborah uses yoga, meditation, mindful walks, and photography to feel balanced and grounded; she calls walks a reboot. Jolene has practiced yoga for 3 years, likes savasana, and uses yoga to manage study/work stress. Jolene received Battlefield 1 for a console the week before 2023-08-21.

During the week of 2023-08-14 to 2023-08-20, Deborah attended a yoga retreat near her deceased mother's place. Deborah said spending time in nature and getting to know herself made the retreat beautiful and life-changing. Deborah shared a photo of a mossy forest trail with trees.

Deborah said that nature and self-reflection had recently made life feel especially meaningful. Deborah felt that every moment is beautiful and that people can grow and learn by listening to themselves. Deborah shared a photo of a mountain range beneath a colorful sunset.
records.topic: Meaning of life and personal growth

records.text: Jolene said that connecting with nature is her own way to relax. Jolene shared a photo of a man bending over on a blanket in grass.
Jolene's goal is to succeed in her field and make a positive impact. To pursue this goal, Jolene has been studying, attending workshops, and networking.

Jolene presented at a virtual conference and received positive feedback. Jolene felt thrilled and rewarded because she knew her efforts were appreciated; the experience confirmed that she was on the right track.
Jolene planned to continue studying and gaining experience, and was considering pursuing more internships to improve her skills.

Deborah expressed pride in Jolene's achievements, offered to help, and encouraged Jolene to keep pursuing her goals while enjoying the journey and taking time for herself. Jolene said Deborah's support meant a lot and promised to keep pushing forward while finding joy along the way. Deborah shared a photo of sunflowers in a field at sunset; Jolene shared a photo of a city skyline at sunset beside a body of water.

On 2023-08-25, Jolene and Jolene’s partner had an emotional conversation about how loved ones influenced them and what values those loved ones passed on; the conversation made them feel closer and clarified what matters to them.

Jolene says her mother taught her perseverance and to never give up, while Jolene’s partner’s father taught Jolene’s partner determination. Jolene and her partner feel encouraged by these values despite their loved ones being gone.

Jolene is an engineering student who wants to use her talents to do good, solve important problems, develop new ideas, improve efficiency, and help others in her engineering projects, reflecting her mother’s emphasis on helping people.

Jolene hopes to work on projects that make a meaningful difference to communities, including sustainable initiatives and innovative solutions to environmental issues. She also wants to contribute her skills to organizations focused on social causes.

Jolene is particularly interested in two future engineering projects: developing renewable energy such as solar power to benefit communities and reduce dependence on nonrenewable energy, and finding ways to provide clean water to people with limited access. She says both fit her beliefs about sustainability and helping people in need, though she still has much to figure out before starting.

Deborah believes conversations about loved ones’ values help build relationships and that work connected to personal values becomes more meaningful. She encouraged Jolene to research, take small steps, accept challenges, and connect with herself when facing problems.
Deborah shared a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a beach, which Deborah said reminded her of nature’s beauty during a yoga session.
Jolene has recently been enjoying yoga and meditation as self-care. She says different yoga poses relieve tension and calm her mind, and that yoga and meditation help her recharge.
Jolene and Jolene’s partner are planning to go on a meditation retreat together to deepen their shared yoga and meditation practice.
Jolene shared a photo of a woman in a pink shirt doing a yoga pose.
Jolene has snakes; Jolene said they like watching her relax. Jolene also described one of the snakes as good company that brings a sense of calm.

Deborah has two cats named Luna and Max. In a photo Deborah shared, Luna was sitting on the left and both cats were sitting on a windowsill looking outside. Deborah says the cats bring joy and peace to her home.
Deborah shared a photo showing a brown leather chair and a black-and-white floor; no further context about the photo was given.

Deborah adopted Luna from a shelter. Luna is female and was 5 years old on 2023-08-26.
Deborah really loves cats and believes cats need a home, love, and care.
Jolene praised Deborah for taming and lovingly caring for Max and Luna, and said she was proud of Deborah’s actions.
Deborah shared a photo showing a car with a fan and a mesh bag; the conversation did not explain the photo’s context.

On 2023-08-29, Jolene and her partner returned from an enjoyable trip to Rio de Janeiro, where they attended yoga classes, visited cafes, and went on excursions. Jolene shared a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose in a mirror.
Jolene said the Rio de Janeiro trip introduced her to different kinds of yoga and their backgrounds, increasing her appreciation of yoga.

In July 2023, Deborah visited her mother's former home, a place that holds a special place in Deborah's heart. Deborah views the house as a symbol of her mother's strength and the love her mother shared with Deborah. Deborah's husband was photographed standing in front of the house. Deborah said relaxing outside brought back fond memories.

Jolene meditates at a nearby tranquil spot by a pond with lily pads and a tree in the background. Jolene said meditating there helps her make sense of things, relieves stress, and feels like a restart.

Deborah's favorite spot for pondering and letting things go is a lake with a few trees in the water. Deborah chose it for its soothing atmosphere and pleasant views, which make it ideal for reflection and letting go.

During Jolene's Rio de Janeiro trip, Jolene and her partner visited an old temple and went on excursions, including climbing impressive stairs. Jolene shared a photo of a group of people walking up the stairs.

Deborah visited Rio de Janeiro around 2020 and took a photo on an excursion of a large stone structure with a mountain in the background. Deborah said exploring historical places and learning their stories is enjoyable and that the trip was a great experience.
Deborah shared a photo of a hand holding a piece of paper with writing on it. Jolene asked what the paper said; its writing was not identified in the conversation.

On 2023-08-30, Deborah shared a quote written to her by a friend who, unfortunately, would never be able to support her; Deborah said she missed him being here. The quote was: “Let go of what no longer serves you.”

On 2023-08-30, Jolene said the quote “Let go of what no longer serves you” reminded her to stay focused and let go of what no longer serves them. Jolene referred to another quote in her notebook that also inspires her and shared a photo of the notebook with a quote; the quote's wording is not stated.

On 2023-08-30, Jolene shared a photo of a new potted plant on a patio. Jolene said she chose the plant as a reminder to nurture herself and embrace fresh starts.
On 2023-08-30, Deborah encouraged Jolene to take care of herself and embrace new beginnings. Jolene thanked Deborah, said she would, and they ended their conversation with well-wishes.

In the week before 2023-09-03, Deborah attended an inspiring event intended to help people support one another; she described it as a cool event.

As of 2023-09-03, Jolene was focusing on studying and her relationship with her partner. Jolene and her partner took short trips to the beach to relax, and Jolene appreciated her partner's encouragement of her goals.
Deborah considers her yoga friends her second family; they have supported one another through many difficulties.

On 2023-09-03, Deborah found and shared an old photo from when she first started doing yoga. The photo shows a woman sitting on a yoga mat with two children. Deborah said her mother was her biggest fan and source of motivation and often accompanied her to yoga classes.
When Jolene was 10 years old, her parents gave her a Nintendo game console, which sparked her passion for video games. Jolene shared a photo of a Nintendo console and game controller.

Jolene uses video games to de-stress and take a break from life; she finds getting immersed in a game freeing.
Jolene had many finals coming up during September 2023 and was studying hard; she said the workload was stressful but would be worth it.
After her finals in September 2023, Jolene was considering taking a trip somewhere to relax and recharge; no destination was specified.
Deborah encouraged Jolene about her upcoming finals and offered to help her if needed.

On 2023-09-06, Jolene said she had signed up for a meditation course at a retreat near a lake and was excited to share the experience with her partner and learn new techniques. Jolene shared a photo of a building with a curved roof on a hill.

On 2023-09-06, Jolene said her project was tough but she was continuing to work on it. Deborah encouraged Jolene, praised her strength, offered support, and reminded her to rest.

On 2023-09-06, Deborah said she had recently seen a wonderful sunrise again and shared a photo showing a person walking on a beach with a surfboard. Jolene said the image calmed her, that beach walks relax her, and that the photo reminded her of her last beach getaway, which she remembered as chill and nice.
On 2023-09-06, Jolene suggested that she and Deborah might watch a sunrise together one day. Deborah enthusiastically accepted the idea.

As of 2023-09-08, Jolene and Jolene’s partner planned a camping trip to connect with nature and practice yoga.

On 2023-09-08, Jolene said that a routine helps her manage her responsibilities. She schedules classes, studying, and personal time, and uses yoga and meditation for self-care, balance, and relaxation. Jolene said she had experimented before finding an approach that worked for her.

On 2023-09-08, Deborah and Jolene arranged a coffee date for Friday, 2023-09-15, at 5:00; Deborah accepted Jolene’s suggested time and said she looked forward to meeting. They had first discussed meeting the following Monday, 2023-09-11, and Wednesday, 2023-09-13, but Deborah remembered she had plans on Wednesday, so Jolene proposed Friday instead.

Deborah asked Jolene to bring her some interesting books when they meet for coffee on 2023-09-15. Jolene had said she needed to sort out books from a bookcase before she would be free.

Jolene shared a photo showing a woman doing a yoga pose on a beach.
Jolene said reflecting at the retreat helped her realize she needs relaxation, self-care, and balance alongside her engineering studies. She found the natural beauty inspiring and refreshing.

Jolene said a retreat session about releasing expectations and judgments and savoring the present stood out to her. She recognized that focusing on goals can make her forget to appreciate the journey.

Deborah and Jolene agreed that noticing small moments and being grateful for them can increase happiness. Jolene gave feeling the sun and enjoying a great cup of coffee as examples of small pleasures, and said she was trying to be more mindful and grateful.

Jolene said she was experiencing a new level of joy and happiness. Deborah expressed happiness about Jolene's progress and said she was excited to share the journey with her; Jolene appreciated Deborah's support and said they could do it together.

Deborah said she had recently played an unnamed cat-themed card game in which players draw cards one at a time from a deck and can use them to attack an opponent. Deborah offered to play it with Jolene.
Deborah shared a photo showing two children standing on yoga mats in a room. The children's identities were not specified.
Jolene said she looked forward to meeting Deborah and playing the cat-themed card game with her.

On 2023-09-15, Deborah reconnected with her deceased mother’s old friends. Their stories made Deborah tear up and reminded her how lucky she felt to have had her mother. Deborah said hearing new stories was emotional, both happy and sad, but ultimately comforting.

On 2023-09-15, Deborah said that reconnecting with her mother’s friends gave her a glimpse of her mother’s life beyond what Deborah had known and helped her appreciate her mother more. Deborah and the friends reminisced and looked through her mother’s photos; Deborah described the experience as sweet and special.
A photo Deborah shared on 2023-09-15 shows two women in pajamas taking a mirror selfie; Deborah presented it as a picture of herself and her mother.
On 2023-09-15, Deborah said pictures bring back memories, encourage appreciation for loved ones, and remind her of the strength of love and human relationships.

A photo Deborah shared on 2023-09-15 shows a person walking on a beach with a surfboard. Deborah said the beach is special to her because she got married there and discovered her love for surfing; it is always filled with joy and peace for her.
A photo Deborah shared on 2023-09-15 from her yoga classes shows a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach.
Deborah finds beach yoga peaceful and relaxing; she enjoys the ocean, sand, and fresh air as part of a self-care atmosphere. She agreed that a serene environment can enhance yoga practice.

Jolene shared a photo described as a couple of towels sitting on top of a table while mentioning flower-based meditation in Thailand.
Jolene said her bedroom is her personal haven for peace and rest after a busy day, where she relaxes and recharges. A photo she shared shows a bed with a colorful blanket and pillows.
Jolene shared a photo showing a person holding a snake in a container, describing the pictured companions as her pals.
Deborah shared a photo of a living room with a couch and fireplace on 2023-09-15; the conversation does not establish whose home or room it is.
On 2023-09-15, Jolene said her pet Susie had been with her for two years and was a great companion.
On 2023-09-15, Deborah and Jolene agreed that pets provide priceless love, comfort, and peace, and make life brighter.

On 2023-09-16, Deborah and her neighbor ran a free gardening class for the community. People of various ages attended. Deborah enjoyed bringing people together through gardening, sharing her love of plants, and helping people care for the world.

On 2023-09-15, Jolene and another person tried a scuba-diving lesson and had a great time. Jolene said they found a dive spot they could explore together and that she might someday become a certified diver.
Deborah is interested in underwater life but has not yet tried scuba diving.
On 2023-09-10, Deborah visited her deceased mother's old house and sat on a bench. Deborah found the visit comforting and felt as if her mother's presence guided her and reminded her of her love.
Deborah's deceased mother loved cooking and made wonderful meals filled with love and warmth. The smell of her mother's special dish filled the house and brought the family together.
As a child, Deborah loved that her mother baked her pineapple birthday cakes, which made Deborah feel special. Deborah shared a photo of a pineapple cake decorated with a smiley face.
Deborah shared a photo of a bowl of food with a spoon in it while recalling her mother's cooking.
Deborah shared a photo of a mixer with a whisk in it while discussing cooking memories.

Jolene said she used to bake cookies with someone close to her. Jolene shared a photo of four chocolate-chip cookies on a baking sheet and described warm, gooey chocolate paired with a soft, buttery cookie.
Jolene shared a photo of a person holding an open book on a bed and said reading the book takes her to another world.

Deborah has a large bookshelf in her living room and considers a space for reading important for escaping reality and relaxing with a book. She shared a photo of a living room with a couch and bookshelf.
Jolene has a bathroom with an aesthetic vibe and once read a self-discovery book there that resonated with her. She shared a photo of a bathroom with a black-and-white wall and a wooden stool.
Jolene thinks a cozy nook is essential, and Deborah likes having a cozy place to relax and read.
Jolene has not tried surfing. Deborah shared a photo of a person walking on a beach with a surfboard and then a photo of a man riding a surfboard on an ocean wave while discussing surfing.

Jolene shared a photo of a surfboard painted with a palm tree while joking about what fate awaited her if she tried surfing. Deborah shared a photo of a sunset over the ocean with a boat in the distance during their conversation about arranging an outing.
On 2023-09-20, Deborah said she had a great time at a music festival with her friends, enjoying the lively atmosphere and magical music, and feeling free to dance and move around.

On 2023-09-20, Deborah said music brings people together, helps them express their feelings, and reminds her of her deceased mother’s soothing voice singing lullabies to her. Deborah feels fortunate to have those memories.

Jolene said they had a great time at a music festival the previous year and that festivals let her express herself and escape everyday stress. Jolene also said she had just returned from a trip with her partner.

She shared a photo of a sunset over a valley with a horse, and said the experience made her and her partner feel alive and grateful.
Jolene said that doing yoga against the retreat’s scenic backdrop made her feel connected to nature and herself, peaceful, and thankful.
Jolene recalled that she and her partner once hiked and came upon a waterfall oasis. The peaceful surroundings made her worries disappear, and she found the experience refreshing.
Jolene planned to spend time in nature again in October 2023 and looked forward to reconnecting with nature.

Deborah said watching the blossom tree bloom each spring felt like admiring nature’s artwork, filled her with awe, and helped her appreciate life’s beauty. She sees the tree as a reminder that growth and hope are possible even in difficult times.

On 2023-09-20, Jolene shared a photo of a plant growing from a corner of a building. Jolene said the image represented her belief that she can keep growing through obstacles. She added that noticing small things helps her remember there is always something positive to hold onto during hard times.
On 2023-09-20, Deborah praised Jolene’s plant photo as a symbol of resilience and strength, and said she loves how Jolene finds inspiration in small things. Deborah thanked Jolene for the reminder.
On 2023-09-20, Jolene thanked Deborah and addressed her as “Deb,” saying it was great catching up and encouraging her to keep finding beauty.
